component: Message copy service versus folder receiver contract

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The folder copyMessages IDL documents a nonempty message array and directs JS callers to MailServices.copy.copyMessages. That service handles an empty array by notifying success and returning before folder copying. The checked local-folder receiver instead returns NS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG for empty headers. The same method name therefore does not establish the same caller contract. This patch adds only documentation; the source checks are static and do not prove all protocol behavior.
title: Folder copy preconditions differ from the copy-service empty-list path
